uav moves from one location to another.desc: This action enables a uav to move from one location to another. For example, the uav can move from location_1 to location_2.
uav moves from one location to another.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to move from [position1] to [position2].

uav loads a package.desc: This action enables a uav to load a package at some location if the package is marked as loadable. The uav can only load one package at a time. For example, if uav is holding nothing and package_1 is marked as loadable at location_1, the uav can load package_1 at location_1.
uav loads a package.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to load [object1] at [position1] if [object1] is marked as [state1]. The uav can only load one [object1] at a time.

Mark the next package as loadable.desc: This action enables a uav to mark a package as loadable if the package follows previously delivered package in the order. It also disables the previously delivered package from being loadable again. For example, if package_1 has been delivered and the next package in the order is package_2, this action marks package_2 as loadable and package_1 as no longer loadable.
Mark the next package as loadable.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to mark [object1] as [state1] and mark [object2] as [state2] if [object1] follows [object2].

uav unloads a package.desc: This action enables a uav to unload a held package at the current location, marking the package as delivered. For example, if the uav is holding package_1 and is at location_2, it can unload package_1 at location_2. Package_1 is marked as delivered.
uav unloads a package.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to unload [object1] at [position1], and mark [object1] as [state1].
